item.title: Daily Weather
item.description: Hello there! Let's find out what the weather is like on this Monday, November 16. Monday again. Let's start the week well! Today in Shanghai, it will be cloudy with hardly any sun. The warmest part of the day will be 19 degrees, and the coolest 12. Comfortable enough to forget about the weather altogether. Rain is very unlikely today. Here's something to notice: today is almost exactly as warm as yesterday. Two days the same in a row! Grey skies are still good for the park. Bring your ball! Looking ahead to tomorrow, it will be dull and cloudy, reaching 18 degrees. This week our theme is taking turns. Notice how it feels to wait, and to be waited for. That's your weather report. See you tomorrow!
